traceability.notes: The 007.0-DEV-ERROR-REPORTING story is fully implemented. All specified rules define clear, specific, and consistent error messages via ESLint meta.messages with appropriate placeholders and data fields. Function, branch, format, file, and requirement-level errors each follow the shared conventions, include contextual details (names, paths, details strings), and provide actionable remediation (including ESLint suggestions for require-story-annotation). Edge cases such as filesystem errors are handled gracefully with dedicated fileAccessError diagnostics. Multiple test suites under tests/rules/* explicitly reference this story and assert the exact messageIds, templates, and data payloads, and the Jest test run completes without failures. Therefore, all acceptance criteria and listed requirements for this story are satisfied.
